verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first Rust game engine. Engines can plausibly ship built-in AI assistants that offer suggestions, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows any in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions: the docs cover ECS, rendering, audio, UI and hot-reload, and the probes report no llms.txt and no official MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
